checkpoint: F1.2 console Edge Functions workspace, read side
how_rendered: The real components (ui/FunctionsWorkspace.tsx and ui/functions-workspace/) rendered by a throwaway Vite page with a stub request and a stub fetch for the Test panel (as the Authentication U0 captures were); not a running installation. Captured with headless Google Chrome at exact viewports (desktop 1360 by 896, phone 390 by 844, device scale 1). The page was removed after the captures. The server routes the components call are covered by tests/functions-read.test.ts against the real handler.
panes: Right to left means dir=rtl on the page with English strings, as in U0: the console has no translation layer.

checks.tests: bun test tests/functions-workspace-ui.test.ts (8 tests: wording of times and sizes, search and sort, client examples, tokenizer, tree, chart geometry, no borders or inline styles or browser select or outside address in the sources, every button typed)

interaction_checked: Keyboard on the sort list (ArrowDown opens, Enter picks, focus returns), secret save with an uppercased name and a multi line value, Test send, tabs, delete confirmation not exercised in the render (covered by the typed name rule in code)
not_exercised: A live installation, the real download of a ZIP in a browser (the fetch and the ZIP are tested separately), the CSP in a served build (no inline style attribute exists in the sources; checked by test), Firefox and Safari (the masked secret field uses -webkit-text-security, which Firefox may ignore)
review_fixes: After the independent review: the Test dialog is portalled with the page behind inert, Escape closes the open list first, focus returns to Test; the console's bordered Empty and ErrorMessage are replaced by Nothing and Problem (a test forbids importing them); a new deploy opens once listed; the select is a combobox with aria-activedescendant; the back arrow mirrors; inline code is isolated; the clock is 12 hour with Western digits; Retry on a failed first load; Download shows Preparing; a deploy over an existing name says it replaces; the log filter waits 300 ms; log rows have labels on a phone.

counter_memory.what: 100 functions called every minute for 1440 minutes in one environment, through RequestLog.recordFunction
counter_memory.how: a throwaway Bun script run once on 2026-10-30 (process.memoryUsage().heapUsed after Bun.gc(true), minus the value before); the committed gate is tests/functions-read.test.ts, heap under 40 MiB at the ceiling, not a repeat of the 4.5 MiB figure
